name: Swiss grid
summary: International Typographic Style: a strict six-column grid, one grotesque in three weights, flush-left type, oversized numerals, thick ink rules and one signal accent.
avoid_for: intimate personal stories that want a warm voice
photo-led event recaps with many pictures

rules.grid: Six columns of 136 px with 24 px gutters on 72 px margins (936 px measure). Every block starts on a column line: titles span five columns, body and context sit in the right four columns, sources and labels in the left columns. A 14 px ink bar anchors the top of every slide, a 2 px rule carries the footer.
rules.type: One grotesque (Schibsted Grotesk) in three weights: 800 for titles and numerals, 500 for standfirsts and list items, 400 for body. Titles tight (negative tracking, line-height under 1), flush left, ragged right. Stat numerals set huge in lining figures, kept proportional because the tabular set widens the decimal point; chart values and the folio are tabular. Labels and sources at a fixed 22 px.
rules.density: One idea per slide. Titles hang from the top bar, the rest anchors to the footer rule, so the space between is a deliberate interval, never a dead band. Calm slides (one number, one quote) alternate with dense ones.
rules.accent: One signal accent per slide, applied to one thing: the accent words of the title (full-strength accent, titles are large enough for 3:1), the highlighted bar or line, the 10 px rule over a stat label, the opening quote mark, or the CTA link rule. List numerals, other rules and the other bars stay ink or grey.
rules.photo: In a grid module, edge to edge within its columns, shown whole (contain) on a neutral grey mat. No crop, no filter, no frame ornament.
rules.texture: None. Flat paper, solid ink, the grid does the work.

layouts.cover-a: Poster: logo under the top bar, the title filling the upper grid with its accent words broken out as an oversized line, the standfirst bottom-left in three columns and the photo (if any) as a module in the right three columns.
layouts.cover-b: Split: a solid ink field carries the title across the lower grid; the photo module sits in columns 1 to 3 above it, the standfirst in columns 4 to 6.
layouts.text: Title over five columns hanging from the top bar; body in columns 3 to 6 anchored to the footer, under a short ink rule.
layouts.list: Title over five columns; items on a thick-ruled table, tabular numerals in column 1, text in columns 2 to 6.
layouts.stat: The numeral set huge across the grid, tabular; label in five columns under a thick rule; context in columns 3 to 6 at the foot.
layouts.chart: Title over five columns, the chart heading as a fixed 26 px label on a rule, the chart across all six columns, grey bars, one accent bar.
layouts.quote: Opening mark hanging in column 1, the quote in columns 2 to 6, attribution in columns 2 to 4 anchored to the foot.
layouts.media: Title over five columns, the screenshot or photo across the grid, numbered legend under it.
layouts.logos: Title, then logos in ink on the six-column grid.
layouts.visual: Title over five columns, a bespoke SVG in ink and one accent across the grid.
layouts.cta: Logo under the top bar, the action set large over five columns, the URL on a thick accent rule, the reason in columns 1 to 4.
